route_classes.active: Production implementation, installed registry, checked-in release input, evidence, or example, public CLI/API dispatch, or checked foundation byte used by the installed image.
route_classes.private: Normative specification, conformance fixture, test, fuzz harness or seed, or test-injected route that cannot activate an installed practical profile.

One successor context shape repeated without projection drift in every artifact, route, report, and receipt.

Working name mpk.selection.csharp_members.v1 with the final hash preimage/domain owned by CSHARP-03-T01-W09.
Method/type/binding/boundary/transition sidecars and all compiled profile contracts for the four installed profiles move as one context-bound family.
One complete source-artifact graph adds bindings, closed instances, foundation linkage, boundary linkage, and concrete operation tables; partial success remains forbidden.
No practical foundation is currently registered. The working private identity mpk.csharp.practical.foundation.v1 requires a frozen descriptor and a new content-hash domain before use.
Working wire identity mpk.vir.v2 and a new VIR hash domain; old/new public dual import is forbidden.
Successor request, success, and diagnostic schemas with artifact-free failure and one private transport until activation.
A successor schema/domain covering the new concrete values, operations, regions, and original-byte provenance.
Successor frontend/certificate-stage schemas and manifest domain; input-set domain may remain only if its exact preimage is unchanged.
Post-v2 VC and skeleton schemas plus a new VC domain and a distinct program-assembly binding.
One successor root/tuple/descriptor/candidate/receipt family includes the foundation descriptor and all migrated predecessor tuples.
Successor scan, evidence, reproduction, and receipt schemas repeat the new context and source/VC/foundation linkage.

Successor request/report contracts consume only successor evidence and retain untrusted-helper status.

release root, all five retained tuples, bundle descriptors, candidates, receipts, and hashes

fixtures, examples, reports, documentation, and local release gates
forbidden_partial_states: mixed old/new registry, context, artifact, or hash family

restore_units: installed mpk CLI/API binaries and both checker binaries
all installed frontend and toolchain bundle bytes

whole_image_rollback_set.rollback_rule: Replace the entire installed image from one baseline release; never restore an individual registry, bundle, producer, consumer, route, fixture, or hash in isolation.
